class.name: WeatherRunoff3D
class.brief_description: Rain running off the land over kilometres: where it flows, how much, and how deep.
class.description: A grid round its position over the terrain's heights: depressions filled (Priority-Flood, Barnes et al. 2014), each cell draining to its steepest neighbour (D8), the share of [method WeatherMap3D.get_ground_water_input_at] that runs off by the SCS curve number, routed as linear reservoirs at TR-55 overland and Leopold and Maddock channel speeds. [PhysXRiver3D] and lakes read its discharge to rise in rain, and [WeatherMap3D] wets the ground the runoff flows over. It answers the runoff contract ([method WorldGround.add_runoff_load]): the load moves down the drainage with the water and is handed to [method WorldWater.add_sediment] where the flow reaches open water. See docs/ideas/rain.md.

method.name: add_load
method.description: Puts [param mineral_kg] of silt and clay and [param ash_kg] of ash on the runoff at [param position]; the same as [method WorldGround.add_runoff_load] while this node is in the tree. Load off the map is lost.

method.name: advance
method.description: Steps the runoff [param seconds] on, with the weather's water input.

method.name: bake
method.description: Samples the heights and builds the drainage network.

method.name: bankfull_width
method.description: Bankfull channel width (m) for a drainage area of [param area_km2] km² (Castro and Jackson 2001: 2.37 A^0.38), the width a debris flow runs at.

method.name: channel_velocity
method.description: Leopold and Maddock (1953) mean channel speed (m/s) for [param discharge] m³/s.

method.name: debris_flow_likelihood
method.description: The chance (0..1) a burnt basin makes a debris flow in a storm (Staley et al. 2017, USGS model M1): [param rain15_mm] mm of rain in 15 minutes, [param burnt_steep_share] the basin's share burnt moderate or high on slopes of 23% and more, [param burnt] its mean burn severity (dNBR / 1000) and [param kf] its soil erodibility (K factor).

method.name: debris_flow_volume
method.description: A debris flow's volume (m³; Gartner et al. 2014) from the peak 15-minute rain intensity [param i15_mm_h] (mm/h), the area burnt moderate or high [param burnt_km2] (km²) and the basin's relief [param relief_m] (m).

method.name: get_bake_time_msec
method.description: How long the last bake took.

method.name: get_debris_flows_since
method.description: The logged debris flows (the last 32, as given to [signal debris_flow]) with an id above [param id], oldest first; -1 for all.

method.name: get_delivered_load
method.description: The load (kg: x mineral, y ash) handed to open water so far.

method.name: get_depth_at
method.description: The water held over the cell at [param position], in mm.

method.name: get_discharge_at
method.description: The flow (m³/s) leaving the cell at [param position].

method.name: get_load_at
method.description: The load (kg: x mineral, y ash) carried on the water of the cell at [param position].

method.name: get_map_rect
method.description: The grid's rect in world x and z.

method.name: get_max_discharge_in
method.description: The largest flow (m³/s) leaving any cell in [param rect].

method.name: get_total_load
method.description: The load (kg: x mineral, y ash) on the map's water.

method.name: get_total_storage
method.description: The water (m³) held on the grid.

method.name: get_upstream_area_at
method.description: The area (m²) draining through the cell at [param position].

method.name: is_baked
method.description: Whether the network is built.

method.name: scs_runoff
method.description: The SCS curve number runoff (mm) from [param rain_mm] of rain.

method.name: shallow_flow_velocity
method.description: TR-55 shallow concentrated flow speed (m/s, unpaved) on a [param slope] (rise over run).

members.member: The hours over which past rain counts toward the curve number's storm depth.
Bake when the node enters the tree.
The upstream area (km²) from which a cell flows as a channel.
Physics layers cast against for heights when there is no [member height_source].
The SCS curve number of the land (about 75 for mixed soils and cover).
The likelihood ([method debris_flow_likelihood]) from which a burnt basin's storm makes a debris flow.
Watches burnt basins ([WorldFire]) in heavy rain and starts post-fire debris flows ([signal debris_flow]). Burns fade from 1.5 to 3 years old.
A node with [code]get_height_at(position)[/code] (a terrain); downward rays when empty.
Steps per second of weather time.

signal.name: debris_flow
signal.description: One post-fire debris flow, once per basin per storm (re-armed after a day of weather time). [param event] holds: [code]id[/code] (int, rising), [code]time[/code] (weather seconds), [code]position[/code] (the basin's outlet), [code]probability[/code] ([method WeatherRunoff3D.debris_flow_likelihood]), [code]volume[/code] (m³), [code]rain15[/code] (mm in 15 minutes), [code]i15[/code] (mm/h), [code]basin_area[/code] (km²), [code]burnt_share[/code] (mean severity), [code]burnt_steep_share[/code], [code]relief[/code] (m), [code]path[/code] (PackedVector3Array, the channel from the outlet down to water, flat ground or the map's edge), [code]widths[/code] (bankfull width per path point, m) and [code]severity[/code] (burn severity per path point, 0..1).
